get.summary: Retrieves the list of browser instances available for the current user with filtering and pagination options.
get.description: This method returns the list of browser processes available for the current user with detailed information. Results can be filtered by profile ID or process ID, optionally sorted, and limited by the number of returned entries. Important: these actions are applied only to browser instances launched via the API.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Starting index for pagination.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Filter by profile ID (optional).

parameters.name: processId
parameters.description: Filter by browser process ID (optional).

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Sorting parameters: ConnectionString, ProcessId, ProfileId (optional).

post.summary: Creates a new browser instance for the specified profile.
post.description: This method creates the new browser instance using the specified profile with optional workspace and desktop settings.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the profile to associate with the browser instance (required).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: desktopName
parameters.description: The name of the desktop environment (optional). Defaults to empty.

parameters.name: threadToken
parameters.description: Thread token for the browser instance. To create a new execution thread, pass an empty string (default).

parameters.name: environmentTags
parameters.description: Tags to configure the environment for the browser instance.

parameters.name: commandLineArguments
parameters.description: Custom command line arguments to pass to the browser on startup

post.summary: Creates multiple browser instances for the specified profiles.
post.description: This method is used to create browser instances in bulk for the specified profiles. Ensure that the provided profile IDs are valid and that the specified workspace ID exists.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

parameters.name: desktopName
parameters.description: The name of the desktop environment (optional). Defaults to empty.

parameters.name: keepAlive
parameters.description: Indicates if the browser instances should remain active after creation. true to keep active; otherwise false. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: environmentTags
parameters.description: Tags to configure the environment for the browser instance.

parameters.name: commandLineArguments
parameters.description: Custom additional command line arguments to pass to the browser on startup

delete.description: This method stops the existing browser instance associated with the specified profile. This operation permanently closes the browser instance and releases all associated resources.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: The target browser instance ID (profileId).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

delete.description: This method stops multiple existing browser instances associated with the specified profiles. This operation permanently closes all specified browser instances and releases their resources.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.

post.description: Set browser instance window visibility (show or hide). This method works only for browser instances launched via the API with reveal or conceal options.

parameters.name: profileId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the profile to associate with the browser instance.

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: Visibility value, true - to show, false - to hide

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace identifier. -1 means the default workspace.
